evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep said 'this would take within the next five to ten minutes of your time. Would that be okay?' but did not include the 'quote you can depend on' framing or full time-boxed promise structure. Also did not wait solidly for confirmation before jumping to concerns.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Rep asked 'What are your biggest concerns or what are the most important things that you wanted to answer on this call today?' — this came AFTER the intro, but then immediately asked about probing details (property type, parking, access) before fully exploring the stated concern (pricing) with follow-up depth.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer stated concern: 'Pricing.' Rep responded 'No worries. We'll walk you through how our pricing works and give you the full estimate' and then moved straight into logistics probing without asking 'tell me more about what pricing concerns you' or any follow-up to understand what aspect of pricing mattered most.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No summary reflection. Rep acknowledged 'No worries' but never reflected back 'So what I'm hearing is [your concern about pricing]' or any version of that.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Covered: property type (one-story house), rooms (4BR at origin, 2BR at destination, but only moving 1 room), parking options (driveway or street, both locations), access concerns (none). Missing: floor/stories detail was partially there (one-story, two-story noted), special considerations not explicitly probed, additional rooms/stops not systematically addressed. Partial credit — roughly 4–5 of 7 items touched.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Not asked. Rep never offered packing services.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Yes, rep asked 'how many boxes are we moving?' Customer responded with bags and coats estimate.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep gave typical range: 'a typical one bedroom apartment that normally takes two movers. That is between two and a half to three and a half hours' AND personalized: 'In your case. We're coming from a one story house and we are only moving one bedroom worth of items going to the new location which is like, less than two hours away...we'll send out two movers and the one truck estimated time is between 5:00 to six hours estimated cost would be $1,548.' Both anchor and personalization present.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Full framing present. Rep disclosed: hourly rate ($104/hour per mover), trip fee ($300 for out-of-zone), what's included (truck, gas, taxes, insurance, wraps, pads, bonds, tools), minimum (2.5 hours), increment (15-minute prorating), no hidden fees (repeated twice). Commitment framing strong.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. Rep gave estimate and moved directly to scheduling availability and the explicit ask without asking 'Does that feel fair?' or pausing for customer reaction.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Full delivery. Rep stated: 'we have ontime. Guarantee we value your time. So, if you cannot make it to the time window that we arrange, we immediately start discounting money of your final bill.' Discount terms clear.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Full delivery. Rep stated: 'we have no worry damage coverage included on the already weight that you're paying us. We will provide up to 2000 dollars pre you that is to repair, replace and reimburse for your items.' Coverage amount ($2,000), inclusion in rate (no add-on), and no-deductible framing present.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: Rep did not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' or equivalent closing check. Rep moved directly from Two Promises into scheduling and the ask.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked. Rep went directly from estimate/promises into 'Would you like our help with your move?' without asking 'What's still concerning you about this move?' or any genuine final check.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Not asked. No 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' or equivalent.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Full. Rep asked plainly: 'Would you like our help with your move?' with no built-in out or softening.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Yes. Rep stated: 'no deposit required, no risk and securing your spot. If something comes up and change in your end then you can always reschedule or cancel with a quick call, no fees for that.'
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial. Rep confirmed: date (September 29th), time window (8:30 AM to 9 AM), no deposit, and crew size (2 movers, 1 truck). Missing: phone number not re-confirmed, addresses were discussed but not re-read-back for final confirmation, no crew notes about customer's pricing concern were left. Partial credit — roughly 4–5 of 5 items, with soft spots on address re-confirm and notes.

top_strength: Rep delivered complete pricing transparency with clear fee structure, hourly rate, trip fee disclosure, Two Promises fully explained, and a straightforward explicit ask — the customer knew exactly what they were paying and for what.
coaching_note: Section 2 was reversed: rep asked concerns AFTER jumping into logistics probing, and never followed up on the stated 'pricing' concern with a second layer of discovery — ask 'tell me more about what pricing concerns you' before moving to details, then summarize what you heard back to the customer.
